# SpikingFourierGraphOperator

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A neural architecture combining spiking neural networks with Fourier-based graph operators to process multivariate time series in the spectral domain. Enables efficient temporal-spectral processing on neuromorphic hardware while leveraging graph topology for multivariate dependencies.
